high_level_description: This image is a selfie taken by two individuals in front of a modern architectural structure. The building has a unique design with multiple levels and a geometric pattern, featuring a mix of glass and what appears to be copper or bronze-colored metal. The structure is quite tall and has a futuristic look. The person on the left is wearing a white shirt with blue geometric patterns and has long dark hair. They are also wearing large round sunglasses and have a cheerful expression. The person on the right is wearing a light gray button-up shirt and has short dark hair.
